reason: H0 exclusively exercises JSON decoding through wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens and wuffs_aux::DecodeJson, while S1 changes the stb-compatible image-loading path. It therefore does not fuzz arbitrary image bytes through the changed memory entry points, their image decoder/configuration protocol, pixel-buffer allocation and setup, or desired-channel conversions.
evidence: H0 enables WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON and invokes wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens and wuffs_aux::DecodeJson; it contains no call to any stbi_* or wuffs_drop_in__stb__* function.
S1 changes the public memory-input entry points stbi_info_from_memory and stbi_load_from_memory, including construction of srcbuf with wuffs_base__strip_const_from_u8_ptr.
S1 changes wuffs_drop_in__stb__load0, which selects WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__Y, RGB, or RGBA_NONPREMUL from desired_channels and initializes ic with wuffs_base__null_image_config().

S1 changes wuffs_drop_in__stb__load1, which drives decode_image_config and decode_frame, initializes pc and pb with wuffs_base__null_pixel_config() and wuffs_base__null_pixel_buffer(), and passes allocated storage to wuffs_base__pixel_buffer__set_from_slice.
recommended_action: Add an image-focused harness that feeds fuzz bytes to both stbi_info_from_memory and stbi_load_from_memory, varies desired_channels across supported and unsupported values, checks output dimensions/channel metadata and failure behavior, and frees every successful returned stbi_uc buffer. Include malformed, truncated, and valid image inputs to exercise decoder selection, image-config decoding, pixel-buffer setup, and frame decoding.
